title: PROCESIO Data Model (DataType) config
description: Minimal config to create/edit a PROCESIO custom data model. The builder expands each attribute into a full DataAttributeDto and wraps it in a CreateDataTypeDto. Primitive types resolve to stable platform ids; 'model' references another data model by name or id; 'attributes' defines an inline nested object.

displayName.description: UI display name; defaults to name.

isPublic.description: Whether the model is public in the workspace.

fromJson.description: Platform trick: infer the whole model from a JSON sample (object or JSON string) via /api/DataTypes/generate. Overrides attributes.

attributes.description: The model's fields. Empty is allowed (an empty object model). Omit when using fromJson.

jsonProperty.description: JSON key this field maps to (defaults to name).

isList.description: Field holds a list/array of the type.

hidden.description: Hide the attribute in the model UI.

type.description: A primitive type. Exactly one of type|model|attributes per attribute.

model.description: Reference another data model by name or id (makes this a nested model field).

attributes.description: Inline nested object — its own fields.
